task: Repository onboarding and ongoing connection management for Wisesama
intent: Plan repository onboarding, ongoing connection management, and public discovery for a vulnerability response product.
scope: Read-only reference research; structure and affordances only. No production UI changed, no collections created.

recommended_references.name: Creating a project (import)
recommended_references.decision: Choose an account scope, search repositories, and import one; retain repository and branch context while choosing project name and root directory.

inspected_screens.visible: Account selector and repository search above repo rows, one Import action per row.
Selected GitHub repository and main branch summary above team/project name; Root Directory field with Edit action.

recommended_references.adaptation: Use the same progressive sequence for provider/account -> repository -> branch/inventory path -> parsed preview -> assessment. Root directory maps to a service boundary in a monorepo. Directory selection alone does not establish vulnerability scope: Wisesama must implement importer-aware monorepo dependency closure or label the imported shared lockfile as repository-wide.
recommended_references.do_not_copy: Deployment settings, template gallery, AI build prompt, hosting presets, environment variables or Deploy action.

recommended_references.name: Add repository and branch
recommended_references.decision: Keep repository selection, branch selection and missing-repository permission recovery in the same onboarding step.
recommended_references.visible: Stepped setup; repository search/selection and refresh; explanatory missing-repository hint with Update GitHub permissions; branch picker; monorepo checkbox; Next disabled until required choices.
recommended_references.adaptation: Provide a clear route to grant the Wisesama app access to a missing repository and refresh the picker. Represent branch and monorepo inventory selection explicitly.
recommended_references.do_not_copy: The deployment-specific suggestion to push a commit as a recovery step; it is not established as appropriate for Wisesama.

recommended_references.name: Connecting to a Git repository

inspected_screens.visible: Dedicated Git settings show connected repository identity, external link, Connected just now timestamp, Disconnect action, and a connection-success toast.

recommended_references.decision: A connected repository needs a durable settings surface, not only an onboarding success message.
recommended_references.adaptation: Show repository identity, connection state and access management separately from the project findings. Add Wisesama-specific branch/inventory path, immutable assessed commit, last sync/assessment and sync errors as product requirements.
recommended_references.do_not_copy: PR comments, commit comments/statuses or deployment events: these imply write permissions and are outside the initial read-only scan connection.
recommended_references.limit: The reference shows connection time and disconnect, not Wisesama scan freshness, webhook health, paused/revoked access or failure recovery.

secondary_inspected_reference.visible: Repository list/search with Connect rows; adjacent provider account summary showing GitHub connected user and repo count, Configure account action, and GitLab Connect account.
secondary_inspected_reference.decision: Keep provider account/access management available beside the repo picker. GitLab can be another provider in the same architecture.
secondary_inspected_reference.limit: Blueprint deployment and public-repository URL entry are not required for Wisesama; this screen does not establish ongoing scan status.
